interactives.title: How fast, at this exact instant? — velocity as a limit
interactives.subject: Physics / Calculus
interactives.summary: Shrink Δt and watch the secant through x(t) and x(t+Δt) rotate onto the tangent. Table records each halving so students can predict the limit before it appears.
